```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

```
#visualizing the data & the spike
```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/mayad/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/CelestialCelebs/maya_research")
mars <- read_csv("mars_daily_views.csv")
spikes <- read_csv("mars_spikes.csv")

```


```{r, fig.wdith=10, fig.height=5}
ggplot(mars, aes(x=date, y=views)) + geom_rect(data=spikes,
                                                aes(xmin=start, xmax=end, ymin=-Inf, ymax=Inf),
                                                inherit.aes=FALSE, fill = "blue", alpha=.2) +
  geom_line(color="purple", linewidth=.4)+ geom_point(data=spikes,aes(x=date,y=views), color="red",size=3)+
  geom_text(data = spikes, aes(x = date, y = views),
            label = str_wrap("NASA's Perseverance rover completes its first 10 days on Mars", width = 30),
            hjust=-.1, vjust = 1, size = 3.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma,
                     expand=expansion(mult=c(.05,.2))) + labs(title="Daily Wikipedia views for Mars", x="date", y="views per day")


spikes
```
